stages.title: Build your fundamentals
stages.intro: Start here — core concepts, log analysis, and networking reasoning underpin everything else on this roadmap.

stages.title: Get hands-on with tools and real scenarios
stages.intro: Next, turn concepts into muscle memory — hands-on tool practice plus vulnerability, OWASP, and incident-response reasoning.

stages.title: Earn a recognized certification
stages.intro: With the fundamentals in place, a certification is the fastest way to make your skills legible to recruiters and ATS filters.

stages.title: Build scripting and automation skills
stages.intro: Basic scripting lets you automate the repetitive parts of the job and stands out even at fresher level.

stages.title: Polish how you present yourself
stages.intro: Finally, make sure your CV actually shows the soft skills hiring managers screen for, not just technical ones.
